services_heading: Central Heating & Plumbing Services Across Sunderland
services_subhead: From routine boiler servicing to emergency repairs and full system installations, we handle every aspect of your heating and plumbing.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Diagnosis
services.desc: Fast fault diagnosis and same-day repair for broken boilers, leaks, and loss of pressure. We carry common parts on the van to get you back to normal quickly.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: New boiler and system installation with full certification and a warranty that covers parts and labour. We'll advise on the most efficient model for your home.

services.title: Annual Boiler Servicing
services.desc: Essential annual check-ups to keep your boiler efficient, safe, and under warranty. Catch problems early and save on energy bills.

services.title: Radiator & Pipework Repairs
services.desc: Leaking radiators, frozen pipes, and blockages cleared quickly. We'll replace corroded sections and bleed air from your system to restore full heat.

services.title: Power Flushing
services.desc: Deep clean of your central heating system to remove sludge and debris that reduce efficiency. Restores heat flow and cuts your fuel costs.

services.title: Emergency Callouts
services.desc: Available 24/7 for heating emergencies. No call-out charge — you pay only for the work done and parts used.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I was tired of cowboys taking advantage of people in an emergency.
about_para_1: Darrin Forse has been serving Sunderland's heating and plumbing needs for over 18 years. What began as a one-man operation built on honest pricing and real expertise has grown into the area's most trusted independent central heating service. Darrin is Gas Safe Registered and carries full public liability insurance — every job is done to the highest standard.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on showing up on time, diagnosing the real problem (not selling unnecessary work), and fixing it right first time. Hundreds of Sunderland households and businesses rely on us for their annual services and emergency repairs. We're still a local, owner-run operation — that means you get continuity and someone who actually cares if you're left without heat in winter.
reviews_heading: What Sunderland Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a complete boiler breakdown on a Sunday evening. Called Darrin expecting to wait until Monday but he came out same night and got us back on within two hours. No pressure to buy a new boiler — he fixed what was broken and gave us a fair price. Absolutely brilliant.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Been using Darrin for my annual services for five years now. Always professional, always on time, and he explains exactly what he's doing. Knows my system inside out. This year he spotted a small problem before it became expensive — that's the kind of service you pay for.
reviews.author: Sarah L.

reviews.text: Radiator started leaking into the living room carpet and I panicked. Darrin came out the next morning, found the problem, replaced the valve, and was done by lunchtime. No fuss, no nonsense, reasonable price. Would recommend him to anyone.
reviews.author: James W.
